standard_prerequisites.name: The affine blowup algebra of an ideal with respect to one of its elements, described as a quotient by the affine blowup relations modulo torsion
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source lines 4562-4566 and attributed to a lemma of the cited chapter (a cross-chapter pointer)
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the presentation of the algebra whose Tor modules the statement bounds.

standard_prerequisites.name: The Koszul complex of the blowup relations and the identification of Tor with the homology of the derived tensor product
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof at source lines 4566-4602
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the annihilation statement to a statement about the homology of an explicit complex in high degrees.

core_obligations: Present the algebra: the proof recalls the description of the affine blowup algebra as the quotient of a polynomial ring by the blowup relations modulo its torsion (proof lines 4562-4566)
Build the Koszul complex: it forms the Koszul complex on the blowup relations and uses that its higher homology vanishes in degrees beyond the number of generators (proof lines 4566-4590)

Annihilation in high degrees: the proof shows that the homology of that complex tensored with the module is annihilated by a power of the chosen element, in all degrees past the number of generators (proof lines 4590-4600)
Conclusion: since that power generates the same ideal in the blowup algebra and the Tor module is a module over it, the stated annihilation holds (proof lines 4600-4602)
proof_roadmap: 把仿射 blowup 代数 B 写成多项式环对 blowup 关系取商再去 a_1-挠。
对 blowup 关系取 Koszul 复形：当 i > t-1 时 Tor_i^A(B,M) = H_i(C_∙ ⊗^L M) 被 a_1^c 杀死；又因 a_1^c B = I^c B 且该 Tor 是 B-模，得到被 I^c 杀死。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement bounds the Tor modules of an affine blowup algebra in degrees beyond the number of generators of the ideal (author lemma at source lines 4554-4560, label lemma-annihilates-affine): there is a c with Tor_i(B, M) annihilated by the c-th power of the ideal for all modules M and all i at least the number of generators. The proof (source lines 4562-4602) uses the presentation of the blowup algebra as a quotient modulo torsion, builds the Koszul complex on the blowup relations, and shows the relevant homology is annihilated by a power of one generator; the final step converts that power into a power of the whole ideal using that the Tor module is a module over the blowup algebra (proof lines 4600-4602). The Koszul bookkeeping and the final conversion are the content. H2.
